verdict.rationale: Baseten documents background execution primitives: async inference returns a request ID and completes later via webhook or polling, and managed training jobs run in containers while checkpoints sync as the job progresses. Neither amounts to a user-configurable automation system that runs autonomously, so the story is only glancingly covered. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-triggered jobs, event-triggered automation workflows, autonomous agent or task runners, and any hands-on corroboration of background automation use.
